question: Can the Timekeeper post into both rooms with one scope=all connection and the /message route?
summary: One connection covered 2 rooms. POST /message succeeded for both rooms. The desk watcher saw the desk post: true. The bridge watcher saw the bridge post: true. Note: a scope=all connection receives every room it belongs to, each event tagged with its room_id.
environment: switch-core started from the cloned repository with a local Postgres, no Docker, in a Claude Code cloud session. Not the Codespace server.
